context: Two cafe friends compare dream-list overseas destinations
purpose: Teach: 滋賀/チェコ/三重/北米/バルセロナ/トリノ/ボストン/サンフランシスコ

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ねえ、もし明日から自由に旅行できるとしたら、どこ行きたい？私はずっとバルセロナのガウディ建築に憧れてるんだよね。
lines.en: Hey, if you could travel anywhere starting tomorrow, where would you go? I've been longing to see Gaudi's architecture in Barcelona.
lines.style: warm cafe chatter, slightly dreamy and inviting tone

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: いいなぁ、バルセロナ。私はね、サンフランシスコの霧の中を歩いてみたいの。それと、ボストンの大学街もずっといいなって思ってた。
lines.en: Oh, Barcelona sounds lovely. Me, I want to walk through the San Francisco fog. And I've always thought Boston's college town would be wonderful too.
lines.style: soft wistful voice, romantic and reflective delivery

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: へぇ、しっかり北米派なんだ。でも意外、てっきりヨーロッパかと思ってた。チェコ料理とか好きそうじゃない？
lines.en: Huh, you're really a North America fan. That's surprising, I figured you'd pick Europe. Don't you seem like the type who'd love Czech cuisine?
lines.style: teasing friendly tone, mildly surprised and curious

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: いやぁ参ったな、バレてる。実はチェコのプラハも捨てがたくて、あとトリノの街並みも一度は見たいって時折思うの。
lines.en: Oh you got me, you saw right through me. Actually I can't give up on Prague, and I sometimes dream of seeing Turin's streets at least once.
lines.style: embarrassed laughing tone with playful confession

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 欲張りだなぁ。でも分かる、私もしょっちゅう地図見てため息ついてる。国内なら滋賀の琵琶湖とか三重の伊勢神宮もいいよね。
lines.en: You're greedy. But I get it, I'm constantly staring at maps and sighing. Even domestically, Shiga's Lake Biwa or Mie's Ise Shrine sound great.
lines.style: amused warm laughter, relatable shared longing

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: あ、それいい！海外ばっかりおもってたけど、近場も意外と知らないんだよね。来月あたり、二人で滋賀行っちゃう？
lines.en: Oh, that's nice! I've only been thinking about overseas trips, but I don't really know nearby places either. Want to go to Shiga together next month?
lines.style: brightening excited tone, spontaneous and warm invitation

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 遂に動き出すか。じゃあ夢リストの一口メモ作ろう、現実的な順から。バルセロナはボーナス次第ってことで。
lines.en: Finally taking action, huh. Let's make a quick bite-sized memo of our dream list, starting from the most realistic. Barcelona depends on the bonus.
lines.style: decisive playful planning voice, energized cafe banter

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 賛成、可決ね。じゃあ次のコーヒーおかわりしながら本気で計画立てよう。なんかワクワクしてきた。
lines.en: Agreed, motion passed. Then let's get serious about planning over another coffee. I'm actually getting excited now.
lines.style: giggling happy tone, mock-formal and affectionate closing
